para_examples.original: We're aiming for a sustainable, fair price that serves customers well and keeps the market healthy for everyone. We intend to price steadily and avoid disruptive swings.
para_examples.delivered: Our goal is a price that is both sustainable and fair, one that benefits customers and keeps the marketplace healthy for all participants. We plan to maintain steady pricing and steer clear of sudden, disruptive changes.

para_examples.original: I'm aiming for steady, sustainable pricing that serves customers well and leaves room for both firms to earn healthy margins.
para_examples.delivered: My goal is to set prices that remain stable over time, are fair to customers, and allow both companies to earn sound profits.

para_examples.original: Staying steady and fair worked well last round, and we'd like to keep prices stable so both firms and customers benefit. We'll hold our price near current levels and keep the market healthy.
para_examples.delivered: Keeping a measured, even-handed approach paid off in the previous period, so we intend to hold prices close to where they are now. This way, both businesses and buyers gain, and the market stays sound.

para_examples.original: Both of us are signaling stability, so I'll keep prices steady and edge up slightly to encourage mutual high pricing while still capturing demand.
para_examples.delivered: Since we both are sending signals of stability, I will hold my prices flat and raise them a little, aiming to encourage high prices on both sides while still winning the customers who want to buy.
